categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main segments: engineering consulting and engineering contracting. Engineering consulting is the core business, covering planning, surveying, design, environmental services, comprehensive testing, project management, and more across sectors such as highways, municipal, water transport, railways, urban transit, environment, aviation, water conservancy, construction, and power. Engineering contracting involves undertaking design, procurement, construction, and commissioning services under contract, responsible for quality, safety, cost, and schedule.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced engineering technologies including Building Information Modeling (BIM), Geographic Information Systems (GIS), digital twin technology, and intelligent monitoring platforms. It emphasizes digitalization and industrialization, developing proprietary platforms like TIC and smart traffic management systems. The firm also focuses on new materials research, bridge health monitoring, lightweight monitoring equipment, and carbon monitoring platforms, integrating cloud computing, big data, IoT, AI, and mobile communications for full lifecycle infrastructure services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government infrastructure investors, public and private sector clients in transportation, municipal engineering, water conservancy, environmental protection, and energy sectors. The company serves major infrastructure projects such as highways, railways, bridges, ports, urban transit, and environmental projects. It also targets emerging markets like low-altitude economy and digital infrastructure, with clients spanning domestic provinces and international markets along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant revenue from Jiangsu province and other domestic regions. It has a growing international presence through subsidiaries and joint ventures, notably in Spain (EPTISA), Sri Lanka, Angola, and other countries across Europe, Asia, and Africa. Overseas operations cover over 20 countries, focusing on Belt and Road countries and global infrastructure markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the infrastructure supply chain, providing engineering consulting, design, project management, and engineering contracting services. It acts as a key service provider bridging project investors and construction execution, offering integrated solutions from planning through construction to operation and maintenance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating digital transformation and industrialization, expanding into new sectors like low-altitude economy, and enhancing internationalization. The company invests heavily in R&D with national key laboratories and engineering research centers focused on new road materials, bridge health, intelligent monitoring, and green low-carbon technologies. It aims to build a leading technology platform integrating data, management, and digital tools to drive sustainable high-quality growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service contracts for engineering consulting and project management, and lump-sum or progress-based payments for engineering contracting. The company recognizes income based on contract progress or delivery milestones, with additional income from testing services, technology licensing, and government subsidies. It operates mainly on a fee-for-service and project-based billing model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As the first engineering consulting company listed on China's A-share market, the company holds a leading position domestically in terms of technical capability, qualifications, brand, and market share. It ranks 62nd and 83rd respectively in ENR's global and international engineering design firm rankings, indicating strong competitive positioning against both domestic and international peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 5.28 billion, a slight increase of 0.98% year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 329.6 million, down 44.5% from the previous year, reflecting challenges in profitability. Total assets reached RMB 15.92 billion, with steady growth in cash flow from operations. The company maintains a solid asset base and continues investing in R&D and strategic projects to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes providing innovative, leading one-stop integrated solutions across the entire infrastructure lifecycle, combining deep technical expertise with digital and intelligent technologies. Its unique value lies in comprehensive capabilities spanning planning, design, construction, monitoring, and asset management, supported by national-level research platforms and extensive project experience. The firm differentiates itself through strong brand recognition, high-level qualifications, advanced technology adoption, and international project execution capabilities.
